class.name: ChorusProjectSettings
class.description: The selected [code]res://chorus/settings.json[/code] document is authoritative. [code]chorus/generation/settings_path[/code] can select another project-contained file. Common Project Settings choices use an empty Dictionary to mean absent and a Dictionary with a typed [code]value[/code] entry to select a value; seed uses decimal text. These methods return a Dictionary with integer [code]status[/code] and string [code]message[/code]. The installed EditorPlugin automatically saves valid edits only in the editor process and prompts for reload on external changes. Gameplay edits are memory-only unless explicitly saved.

method.name: sync_generation_defaults
method.description: Validates Project Settings choices and applies them to later generation admissions in memory. Invalid input keeps the previous valid choices.

method.name: reload_generation_defaults
method.description: Imports the selected JSON again, replacing cached Project Settings choices. A failed reload leaves the last valid snapshot and source selected.

method.name: save_generation_defaults
method.description: Explicitly persists current choices, including from gameplay, after checking the source and detecting external changes. A failed source, malformed destination or external change is never overwritten.

constants.constant: A generation choice has an invalid type or value. The previous valid choices remain active.
